description: 松山機場入境人次預報 [airports] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 內政部移民署. 松山機場入境人次每小時更新近3小時入境人次. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 內政部移民署. Its tags are 休閒旅遊. It offers 1 resource(s) in json. The portal shows 2025-12-15 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support airport and airspace-related planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
